title: ECI Position to LLA
text: Convert Earth-centered inertial (ECI) coordinates to geodetic latitude, longitude, altitude (LLA) coordinates, 6 inputs, 1 output, {Month} sets Month; {Reduction}, {Year}, {Day}, {Hour}, {Minutes}, {Seconds}, {Time increment}, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Higher accuracy parameters} enables higher accuracy parameters, {Units} sets the output units Metric, {Earth model}, {Flattening} and {Equatorial radius} sets the radius. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ΔUT1
ports.summary: Difference between UTC and Universal Time scalar

ports.name: ΔAT
ports.summary: Difference between International Atomic Time and UTC scalar

ports.name: Port_5
